title: About Us
text1: Since 1953, our heritage has been rooted in the world of pharmacy. What began as Doga Pharmaceutical Raw Materials, a trusted pharmaceutical raw material depot supplying the highest quality ingredients to over 5000 pharmacies across Turkey, has grown into a new expression: Bossforskiy Cosmetics.
text2: Not a subsidiary, but an extension of this legacy, Bossforskiy carries forward decades of pharmaceutical expertise into the world of beauty. Every formula is crafted with precision, blending time-honored ingredients with modern innovation to deliver visible results and a luxurious sensory experience.
text3: Our first and flagship creation is a moisturizing cream — a symbol of comfort, softness, and elegance in every touch. With its compact, refined packaging, it turns daily care into everyday luxury.
text4: Looking ahead, Bossforskiy is expanding into a complete universe of beauty. Our mission is to become a globally recognized name, trusted by women for quality, elegance, and timeless care.
